reviews.title: How did you come up with these ratings?
reviews.text:
They don’t provide any exclusive information. It’s completely unclear where their numbers come from. Any information you can actually rely on is available from official sources—and you can access those yourself.

It may be a good platform for advertising and generating business for immigration attorneys, but it’s not very useful for people who are actually waiting for a decision on their case.

In my opinion, it’s expensive and doesn’t provide enough value to justify the cost.

reviews.title: Unclear benchmark numbers
reviews.text:
It’s not clear what the numbers it reports are actually referring to. The whole point of this is to gushes when is your next step likely to happen and there is a “number of days” but it’s not clear which day this number is measured from, does it account for silent updates, etc. 

Separate issue is it looks like it just updates whenever you open the app and doesn’t work in the background to keep your data updated for the app. If we wanted to log in every time, we’d just do it on the USCIS website.

reviews.title: Horrible and useless app
reviews.text: The free trial offer pops up even if you did it before and when you click it, it charges you for subscription. The help email refers to Apple and I still havent been paid back. If you want to get more detailed information about your cases, use reddit and discord (you can find the link on reddit). Its totally free and has per field office trackers as well (much better forecasting than whatever lawfully does).

reviews.title: Beware!! Charged me even after I canceled my trial
reviews.text: They offered a free 3 day trial so I subscribed to see the features. Before my trial was up I followed their instructions to cancel the subscription via Apple but 2 weeks later I was charged for their monthly premium. I went to their Help section but nobody answered the chat, just AI bot. Be careful of what you click in the app as well, you might accidentally subscribe to stuff.

reviews.title: Love the app BUT
reviews.text: App is not reliable. They need to fix the core thing before doing other things. I appreciate the app being free and that it does not spam you with ads like other app BUT, my case got approved like 5 days ago, app still did not update the case to approved. Even though I open the case and you would think its updated, but no, it does not update, even when you use check online option and it says “case approved” it still does not update even though. I think its misleading if you dont tell the user “hey we update the app every 5 days and the refresh does not do anything actually” not sure whats going on, but the core feature does not work properly. One of my cases did update after 2 days and thats after me refreshing.

reviews.title: Poor Subscription process
reviews.text: Very disappointed with Lawfully’s subscription process. It’s extremely unclear and feels misleading. The app advertises a 3-day trial, but what they don’t make obvious is that you have to actually sign up for a 3-month subscription to get 3 days trial, and this isn’t clearly stated at the time of purchase. Important details about what you’re being charged for are hidden or not shown at all.
